event: News Lab learned not to collapse the public shelf for repairable image/date/cache issues.
plainEnglish: Approved articles inside the seven-day window must remain visible while image relevance, prepared cache freshness, and publish-date continuity are repaired in the background.

realWorldData.observedProblem: public site showed fewer tiles than durable approved shelf
causes: underfilled prepared API cache could override durable payload
image topic mismatch was treated as display removal instead of repair work
continuity layer could store generatedAt as original publish date

proceduralMemory.futureUse: When approved visible articles shrink, compare durable payload count, prepared API cache count, board visibility count, and image readiness findings before changing writer/editor standards.

event: Framework learned that repairable content failures must stay in the lifecycle.
plainEnglish: News Lab, Creator Desk, and Newsletter failures were symptoms of a shared flow issue: some stages identified repairable public-language problems and then dropped or saved the item instead of repairing, resubmitting, publishing, and measuring the result.

rootCause: pre-editor internal-language candidates could be removed before review
content lanes stopped after one rewrite attempt
learning records existed without guaranteed behavior change before the next draft

proceduralMemory.futureUse: For every article/newsletter/Creator Desk rejection, keep the item in a repair state, fix all detected issue groups, resubmit through the same gate, publish only if passed, and teach upstream/downstream systems by failure class rather than exact text.
